name: Freeport-McMoRan
description: Freeport-McMoRan is one of the world's largest publicly traded copper miners, ranked third among producers with about 5% of world mined copper (Wood Mackenzie, Dec 2025, cited in its 10-K). 2025 revenue was 75% copper, 15% gold and 8% molybdenum. Gold comes almost entirely from the Grasberg district in Indonesia, so a single mine complex supplies the gold and about 30% of copper. Freeport sells concentrate and cathode at market prices (LME copper, London gold) with provisional pricing settled after delivery, so profit swings with metal prices and volume rather than with any sales effort. In September 2025 a mud rush at the Grasberg Block Cave halted production there; the mine is in a phased ramp-up back to full capacity from Q2 2026. FCX owns only 48.76% of the Indonesian operation (PT Freeport Indonesia) but consolidates it, so about $1.3B of 2025 profit went to minority holders there.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge; not re-checked against MSCI/S&P. SEC SIC 1000 (Metal Mining).

employees.note: About 29,000 employees: 13,900 US, 7,300 South America, 6,600 Indonesia, 1,200 Europe/other (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Indonesia operations (PT Freeport Indonesia, Grasberg)
businessLines.how: Sells copper concentrate and (now) refined copper and gold at market prices; gold is a by-product credit that makes it the highest-margin unit. 2025 was hit by the Sept 2025 mud rush.
businessLines.description: Grasberg copper-gold district plus a new smelter and precious-metals refinery at Gresik completed in 2025.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating income before corporate/eliminations (-$1,094M); share computed against the $7,612M sum of segments

businessLines.name: South America operations (Cerro Verde, El Abra)
businessLines.how: Sells copper concentrate and SX/EW cathode at market prices; large-scale, low-grade ore.
businessLines.description: Cerro Verde in Peru (55.08% owned) and El Abra in Chile; copper with by-product molybdenum and silver.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating income before corporate/eliminations (-$1,094M); share computed against the $7,612M sum of segments

businessLines.name: US copper mines (Morenci, Bagdad, Safford, Sierrita, Miami, Chino, Tyrone)
businessLines.how: Sells cathode and concentrate largely to FCX's own rod and refining and smelting units at market prices.
businessLines.description: Seven Arizona and New Mexico copper mines (Morenci is 72% owned).

operatingProfit.note: segment operating income before corporate/eliminations (-$1,094M); share computed against the $7,612M sum of segments

businessLines.name: US molybdenum mines (Henderson, Climax)
businessLines.how: Sells molybdenum at market price; most sales are intersegment ($754M).

operatingProfit.note: segment operating income before corporate/eliminations (-$1,094M); share computed against the $7,612M sum of segments

businessLines.name: Rod and refining
businessLines.how: Converts copper into rod sold to wire and cable makers for a small conversion margin over the metal price; pass-through revenue.
businessLines.description: Copper rod, cathode and refining and a smelter (Miami, Arizona), buying mostly from FCX's own mines.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating income before corporate/eliminations (-$1,094M); share computed against the $7,612M sum of segments

businessLines.name: Atlantic Copper (Spain)
businessLines.how: Smelts and refines purchased concentrate for a treatment and refining charge; margin is thin.
businessLines.description: Copper smelter and refinery in Huelva, Spain.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating income before corporate/eliminations (-$1,094M); share computed against the $7,612M sum of segments

whatsNext.text: Phased restart and ramp-up of the Grasberg Block Cave underground mine to full capacity after the Sept 2025 mud rush; second-half 2026 copper sales expected above first half

Indonesia MOU (Feb 2026) extending Grasberg operating rights beyond 2041; FCX ownership stays 48.76% through 2041, then about 37% from 2042. Described as an MOU, not final agreements, in the text read
